raw_segments.text: I shall not rest satisfied with merely employing my capital in ensuring ships.
I shall buy up some good life assurance shares and cut into the direction.
I shall also do a little in the mining way.
None of these things will interfere with my chartering a few thousand tons on my own account.
I think I shall trade," said he, leaning back in his chair,
to the East Indies for silks, shawls, spices, dyes, drugs, and precious woods.
